<Subject 1> is the adult woman in <Picture 1>, preserving her facial identity, apparent age, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and visible accessories. The photo also supplies the setting, lighting direction, and color palette.

summary:
[reference generation] An approximately {a:g}-second realistic portrait video of <Subject 1>, guided by <Picture 1>. A single continuous shot develops the requested gesture and camera movement while retaining the reference person's identity and presentation.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the same facial identity, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and proportions throughout the clip. The setting and lighting follow the supplied photo.

detailed_description:
The target video has a realistic live-action portrait style, with photographic lighting and naturally resolved skin detail. The requested action determines the movement amplitude and shot size. The output follows the aspect ratio selected in the workflow. Treat the supplied image as a reference for the person and setting rather than a sequence of panels.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1>, the adult woman from <Picture 1>, is the sole visible person. Choose a comfortable composition that fits the requested action. For a small expression or head turn, keep her head and shoulders comfortably inside the frame. For walking or a larger body gesture, widen to a three-quarter or full-body view so the movement remains readable. Match the reference person's facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, hairline, hairstyle, outfit, and visible accessories. Preserve the reference's lighting direction and overall color relationships. Keep the background recognizable through the shot, with natural perspective and a depth of field suited to a portrait. Let existing background objects remain stationary as the subject moves.

The requested action and camera direction for this shot are: {b}

Develop the gesture smoothly over the full available clip. The opening establishes her starting pose with calm, settled body weight. The middle carries the requested action through a physically continuous movement. The final portion lets the gesture resolve into a relaxed pose rather than an abrupt freeze. Use small intermediate changes in her head angle, gaze, cheeks, and shoulders so the action reads as a continuous performance. Keep the eyes aligned with the head movement and let the neck and shoulders follow naturally. Maintain coherent hair strands and fabric folds as they respond to the motion.

Favor natural skin texture, soft tonal transitions, and stable facial features across frames. Maintain ordinary facial asymmetry and consistent complexion. Render eyelashes, lips, jewelry, and clothing edges with coherent detail at the selected resolution. Hands, when they are visible in the reference framing, remain anatomically consistent and move only when the requested gesture needs them. Keep the outfit and accessories consistent throughout the shot.

Execute the requested camera move at a steady pace. Favor low amplitude when the action description does not request a larger movement. Preserve a consistent lens perspective and stable exposure, with smooth focus behavior centered on the face. The view remains one continuous shot for the whole clip, without a cut or a sudden change of location. The woman remains silent. Quiet ambience and the small physical sounds of hair or fabric may accompany the movement.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet ambience appropriate to the reference setting, with subtle synchronized fabric movement. No dialogue or singing.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> 是 <Picture 1> 中的成年女性。保留她的面部身份、五官、脸型、肤色、妆容和身材比例。头发自然披散，服装改为下文指定的穿搭。

summary:
[reference generation] 生成约 10 秒的横屏窗边人物写真短片，包含七个镜头。<Subject 1> 穿浅粉色荷叶边短上衣和奶油白色高腰短裤，在粉色扶手椅与落地窗附近，手持一颗红苹果完成自然的写真姿势。

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4], [Shot 5], [Shot 6], [Shot 7]): partially_preserved - 保留参考图中的面部身份、五官、脸型、肤色、妆容和身材比例；替换原服装。所有镜头保持同一张脸、同一套服装和同一颗红苹果。

detailed_description:
真人实拍风格，总时长约 10.1 秒。整体是柔和、清甜、轻熟的时尚写真，动作舒展自然，眼神放松，表情细腻。

场景为明亮的窗边房间：米灰色立体纹理墙面，粉色软垫扶手椅和同色抱枕，落地窗前挂着白色纱帘和米色窗帘，地面铺有浅灰色纹理地毯。柔和窗光从侧面照入，皮肤和头发带有自然光泽。

<Subject 1> 穿浅粉色蕾丝荷叶边短上衣，带细肩带和柔软褶皱，内层不透明；下装为奶油白色高腰短裤。服装以参考图为准，全片保持款式、颜色和材质一致。

红苹果为大小自然、表面光滑的完整苹果，握持位置清楚，手指自然。

[Shot 1]
坐姿细节近景。镜头从粉色椅子的边缘和人物自然屈膝的坐姿开始，缓慢向上移动，带到她握着红苹果的双手，再接近上半身。运镜平缓，窗光柔和。

[Shot 2] At 00:01.750
切换到正面中景。<Subject 1> 自然屈膝坐在粉色椅子上，双手捧着红苹果靠近唇边。她看向镜头，轻轻眨眼，头部微微倾斜，保持放松的浅笑。

[Shot 3] At 00:03.125
切换到靠近落地窗的侧面中景。<Subject 1> 坐在椅子前缘，一手拿着苹果，发型以参考图为准。她稍微抬起下巴，头发随着动作轻轻移动。

[Shot 4] At 00:04.375
切换到略高于眼睛的近景。<Subject 1> 将红苹果举到脸颊旁，轻轻歪头，视线跟随镜头。画面突出清晰的脸部、自然妆容和手中的苹果。

[Shot 5] At 00:05.500
切换到较宽的斜侧面镜头。<Subject 1> 侧靠在粉色椅背与抱枕上，双腿自然弯曲，一手持苹果停在肩侧，另一只手轻轻拨弄发丝。她缓慢转头看向镜头，保持舒展的姿势。

[Shot 6] At 00:07.000
切换到正上方俯拍。<Subject 1> 仰躺在浅灰色纹理地毯上，长发自然铺散在头部周围。她双手捧着红苹果靠近唇边，眼睛看向镜头，轻轻眨眼，表情安静自然。

[Shot 7] At 00:08.625
切换到窗边的中近景。<Subject 1> 坐在椅子前缘，上身轻微前倾，双手将苹果放在膝前。她轻轻转动肩膀，头微微侧倾，看向镜头并露出浅笑，保持到视频结束。

镜头之间使用清楚的直接切换。每个镜头内人物动作轻微、完整自然，面部身份、服装、苹果和房间环境保持连续一致。
